title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use DEXTROMETHORPHAN HYDROBROMIDE AND QUINIDINE SULFATE CAPSULES safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for DEXTROMETHORPHAN HYDROBROMIDE AND QUINIDINE SULFATE CAPSULES. DEXTROMETHORPHAN HYDROBROMIDE and QUINIDINE SULFATE capsules, for oral use Initial U.S. Approval: 2010

sections.indications_and_usage: Dextromethorphan hydrobromide and quinidine sulfate capsules are indicated for the treatment of pseudobulbar affect (PBA). PBA occurs secondary to a variety of otherwise unrelated neurologic conditions, and is characterized by involuntary, sudden, and frequent episodes of laughing and/or crying. PBA episodes typically occur out of proportion or incongruent to the underlying emotional state. PBA is a specific condition, distinct from other types of emotional lability that may occur in patients with neurological disease or injury.
sections.adverse_reactions: A total of 946 patients participated in four Phase 3 controlled and uncontrolled PBA studies and received at least one dose of the combination product of dextromethorphan/quinidine in various strengths at the recommended or higher than the recommended dose. Of those patients, 393 patients were exposed for at least 180 days and 294 patients were exposed for at least one year. Median exposure was 168 days. Controlled trials enrolled only patients with either ALS or MS. Uncontrolled studies enrolled 136 patients with PBA secondary to a wide variety of underlying neurological conditions including stroke (45 patients) and traumatic brain injury (23 patients). Consequently, patients with other underlying neurologic diseases may experience other adverse reactions not described below.
sections.boxed_warning: Dextromethorphan hydrobromide and quinidine sulfate capsules are supplied as follows: 20 mg/10 mg – Each capsule with orange opaque cap and body, printed with and 467 on both cap and body in black ink contains 20 mg of dextromethorphan hydrobromide, USP and 10 mg of quinidine sulfate, USP. Capsules are supplied in bottles of 60 (30 day supply) - NDC 0480-2602-06. Storage Store at 25°C (77°F); excursions permitted to 15° to 30°C (59° to 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Protect from light and moisture. Dispense in a tight, light-resistant container as defined in USP.
